data.name: Gajaanan
data.gender_notes: Gajaanan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gajaanan is a revered name derived from Lord Ganesha, who is known as the elephant-headed god. In Hindu mythology, Ganesha is the god of wisdom, knowledge, and new beginnings. The name 'Gajaanan' represents the strength and wisdom of the elephant and the pride of being a child of the divine. The name Gajaanan carries the meaning “Ganesha's name, meaning 'Gaja' (elephant) and 'Anan' (pride)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gajaanan usually hope their child will grow to embody ganesha's name, meaning 'gaja' (elephant) and 'anan' (pride) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, strength, and the power of new beginnings.
data.etymology: Gajaanan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ganesha's name, meaning 'Gaja' (elephant) and 'Anan' (pride).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gajaanan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
